info.title: Guilloche Studio Pro API
info.description:
API for creating, managing, and sharing mathematical guilloche patterns. This API powers the Guilloche Studio Pro web application, providing endpoints for pattern management, marketplace operations, AI-powered suggestions, and subscription handling.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require authentication via Supabase Auth. Include the authentication token in requests using cookies managed by the Supabase SSR library.

## Rate Limiting

API endpoints are rate-limited based on subscription tier:
- **Free**: 60 requests/minute
- **Pro**: 300 requests/minute  
- **Enterprise**: 1000 requests/minute

## Response Format

All API responses follow a consistent format:

```json
{
  "success": boolean,
  "data": { ... },
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_CODE",
    "message": "Human readable message",
    "details": [{ "path": "field", "message": "Validation error" }]
  }
}
```

get.description: Returns comprehensive health status including all dependent services (Supabase, Cloudflare KV, R2, AI). Use this endpoint for monitoring and alerting.

head.description: Lightweight health check that returns only headers. Use for load balancer health probes.

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's profile information including username, display name, bio, and subscription tier.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile. All fields are optional; only provided fields will be updated.

get.description: Returns all patterns owned by the authenticated user, sorted by last updated date (most recent first).

post.description:
Creates a new pattern with the specified parameters. Pattern limits apply based on subscription tier:
- Free: 3 patterns
- Pro: 100 patterns
- Enterprise: Unlimited

error.message: Pattern limit reached (3 patterns). Upgrade your plan to save more patterns.
A pattern with identical parameters already exists

get.description: Retrieves a pattern by ID. Public patterns can be accessed by anyone; private patterns require ownership.

patch.description: Updates an existing pattern. Only the pattern owner can update it. All fields are optional.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a pattern. Only the pattern owner can delete it. This action cannot be undone.

get.description: Downloads the pattern data as a JSON file. Requires ownership or prior purchase of the pattern.

error.message: You do not have permission to download this pattern. Please purchase it first.

get.description: Returns publicly listed patterns available for purchase. Supports search, filtering, sorting, and pagination.
